title: Overview
query: select 'Surveys' as Metric, count(*) as Value from SURVEY
union all select 'Centrelines', count(*) from CENTRELINE
union all select 'Stations', count(*) from STATION
union all select 'Shots', count(*) from SHOT
union all select 'Explorers', count(distinct PERSON_ID) from EXPLO
union all select 'Surveyors', count(distinct PERSON_ID) from TOPO
union all select 'Length', round(coalesce(sum(LENGTH), 0), 2) from CENTRELINE
union all select 'Surface length', round(coalesce(sum(SURFACE_LENGTH), 0), 2) from CENTRELINE
union all select 'Duplicate length', round(coalesce(sum(DUPLICATE_LENGTH), 0), 2) from CENTRELINE
union all select 'Depth', round(coalesce(max(Z) - min(Z), 0), 2) from STATION

title: Survey Lengths
query: left join CENTRELINE C on C.SURVEY_ID = S.ID
order by Length desc, Survey asc

title: Exploration by Person
query: select P.NAME as Name, P.SURNAME as Surname,
join EXPLO E on E.PERSON_ID = P.ID
join CENTRELINE C on C.ID = E.CENTRELINE_ID
order by ExploredLength desc, Surname asc, Name asc

title: Surveying by Person
query: select P.NAME as Name, P.SURNAME as Surname,
join TOPO T on T.PERSON_ID = P.ID
join CENTRELINE C on C.ID = T.CENTRELINE_ID
order by SurveyedLength desc, Surname asc, Name asc

title: Length by Survey Year
query: where TOPO_DATE is not null and TOPO_DATE <> ''

title: Exploration by Year
query: where EXPLO_DATE is not null and EXPLO_DATE <> ''

title: Recent Activity
query: left join SURVEY S on S.ID = C.SURVEY_ID
where coalesce(C.TOPO_DATE, C.EXPLO_DATE) is not null
order by Date desc, Survey asc

title: Continuation Stations
query: join STATION_FLAG F on F.STATION_ID = ST.ID
left join SURVEY SV on SV.ID = ST.SURVEY_ID
order by Survey asc, Station asc

title: Lead Flags by Survey
query: join STATION ST on ST.ID = F.STATION_ID
left join SURVEY SV on SV.ID = ST.SURVEY_ID
group by SV.ID, SV.FULL_NAME, SV.NAME, F.FLAG
order by Survey asc, Stations desc, Flag asc

title: Entrances
query: join STATION_FLAG F on F.STATION_ID = ST.ID
left join SURVEY SV on SV.ID = ST.SURVEY_ID
order by Survey asc, Station asc

title: Depth by Survey
query: join STATION ST on ST.SURVEY_ID = SV.ID
order by Depth desc, Survey asc
